new_risks.description: P1-E-056 was incorrectly Archived by S800-era autonomous process. Root cause: DL-033 naming confusion ('Pack A Section E' vs. 'Pack E' file) caused cross-file misidentification. The autonomous run searched pack_e_corrected.js for items residing in pack_a_corrected.js — finding 0 hits and concluding the items didn't exist. The 18 Currently-Archived items in Pack A (including 16 Section E clones + P1-E-056 previously) were all processed by the same autonomous pipeline. P1-E-056 was confirmed unique (independent topic: physical count control) and restored. The other 17 Archived items in Pack A are confirmed genuine clones — correctly archived.
questions_open: Were other items incorrectly archived in the same autonomous run? Review of the remaining 18 Pack A Archived items: 17 are genuine clones (confirmed by S801 clone analysis). P1-E-056 was the only incorrectly archived item identified.
Is DL-033 naming confusion a risk for other cross-file operations? YES — any tool that uses pack-file-level operations without section-scope awareness is vulnerable.
Does the S800-era autonomous run's logic need audit? Not urgent — the run archived Pack A Section E clones and most were correct. Only P1-E-056 was a false positive.
new_risks.mitigation: Document DL-033 naming convention in AGENTS.md as a standing caution. Require disambiguation check before any cross-file archive operation: 'Pack E' means pack_e_corrected.js; 'Pack A Section E' means Section E items in pack_a_corrected.js. Audit P1-E-056 restoration for completeness (DL-016/DL-008/DL-026 all confirmed fixed).
new_risks.status: RESOLVED — P1-E-056 restored to Certified. One-off incident confirmed (no other incorrect archives found). Process risk: MEDIUM — naming confusion could recur without explicit disambiguation rule.

new_risks.description: P1-E-056's metadata block (ChoiceA-D, ExplanationWrongA-D) was from P1-E-055 — the classic DL-016 +1 offset pattern. This was fixed during the restoration (genuine choice-specific distractor explanations authored). However, P1-E-055, P1-E-054, P1-E-053, and others in the same rotation group likely have the same DL-016 shift — their metadata blocks advertise the previous QID's topic. P1-E-053 is Certified (unique seed); the remaining 16 Section E items are Archived (clones) and out of learner pool. The risk is that P1-E-053 (Certified, in learner pool) has stale metadata-block choices that don't match its content-block choices, meaning learners who select wrong answers on P1-E-053 could see explanations about P1-E-052's topic.
